source: Tiered Production Pipeline v4 (Dreammini + Ny-Gemini-1.4.5, google/gemini-4-argon, 2026-11-26)

options.label: 让她坐一会儿
options.label_en: Tell her to sit a while

segments.prompt: 她把队伍的单子和一包货一起放上柜台
segments.prompt_en: She sets the squad's list and a bundle of goods on the counter

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 埃莉诺提着帆布包站在窗口前，把一张叠好的手写单子拍在柜台上。
lines.en: Eleanor stands at the window with a canvas bag and slaps a folded handwritten list on the counter.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你先看看这张单子上的东西。
lines.en: Take a look at what's on this list first.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 止血、退烧、消毒，底下是枪。
lines.en: Hemostatics, fever meds, antiseptic. Guns at the bottom.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你写的。
lines.en: You wrote this.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我现在进了革命军，队里对单和出货都归我管。
lines.en: I'm with the Revolution now. I handle the unit's orders and shipments.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 衣服大了一号。
lines.en: Your clothes are a size too big.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 队里发的衣服，肩线直接宽出两指。
lines.en: Unit-issue. The shoulders are two fingers too wide.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 以前在上面做衣服，裁缝总要反复量好几次。
lines.en: When I had clothes made on the Upper Level, the tailor measured me over and over.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 现在只要能套在身上就行了。
lines.en: Now anything I can pull on will do.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 刚才我穿这身走过街口，有人冲地上吐口水。
lines.en: I walked past the corner in this just now, and someone spat on the ground.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 也有人趁我不注意，往我兜里塞了半颗营养果。
lines.en: Someone else slipped half a Nutrifruit into my pocket when I wasn't looking.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 今天就要拿药？
lines.en: You need the meds today?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 今天手头上的钱不够，单子上的货先不买。
lines.en: I don't have enough money today. I'm not buying anything on the list yet.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我先把这包旧工具卖成信用点，你别问来路。
lines.en: First I'm selling this bag of old tools for credits. Don't ask where they came from.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 等过两天凑够了数，我再拿单子过来买药。
lines.en: In a couple of days, once I've scraped enough together, I'll bring the list back for the meds.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 包解开，先看货。
lines.en: Open the bag. Let's see the goods.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: （拉开帆布包）里面都是旧货，有两件边口还带着缺口。
lines.en: (Opening the canvas bag) It's all old stuff. Two pieces have chipped edges.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 前几天治安部叫我去了一趟，让我认尸。
lines.en: A few days ago, Public Security called me in to identify a body.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我一眼就看出来了，我母亲已经死了。
lines.en: I knew at a glance. My mother was dead.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她的头发被人剪短了，我在那张纸底下签了字。
lines.en: Someone had cut her hair short. I signed at the bottom of the form.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 签完字的第二天，营养果的研究资料就贴得满站都是。
lines.en: The day after I signed, the Nutrifruit research was posted all over the station.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那明明是我母亲攒了半辈子的东西。
lines.en: That was half a lifetime of my mother's work.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我知道了。
lines.en: Understood.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你没跟我说什么节哀，这样反倒让我松口气。
lines.en: You didn't tell me you're sorry for my loss. Honestly, that's a relief.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这几天那些空话我已经听够了。
lines.en: I've heard enough empty words these past few days.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她低下头，把包里的旧工具一件接一件挪到柜台木面上。
lines.en: She lowers her head and moves the old tools from the bag onto the wooden counter, one by one.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 出发前队里有人劝我，让我把上面带下来的旧衣服也拿来。
lines.en: Before I left, someone in the unit told me to bring the old clothes I brought down from the Upper Level too.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 他们说多换点信用点，就能给队里多拿几盒药。
lines.en: They said more credits would mean a few more boxes of meds for the unit.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我没把那些衣服带出来，怎么处置得由我自己定。
lines.en: I didn't bring those clothes. What happens to them is my call.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 成色看清了。
lines.en: I've checked the condition.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你按成色老老实实开价，不准凑整也不准多给。
lines.en: Price it honestly by condition. No rounding up, no extra.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我来这里是为了换钱办事，不是来让你可怜的。
lines.en: I'm here to get money and get things done, not to be pitied.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 队里现在缺什么？
lines.en: What's the unit short on?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 止血和退烧药最急，但今天钱不够，先把这包工具换成信用点。
lines.en: Hemostatics and fever meds most of all. But I'm short on money today, so I'm turning these tools into credits first.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 窗边有椅子，坐会儿。
lines.en: There's a chair by the window. Sit for a while.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我不坐，现在要是坐下去我怕自己起不来。
lines.en: I won't sit. If I sit down now, I'm afraid I won't get up.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你先把这包工具看完再说。
lines.en: Finish looking over these tools first.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这个数还算公道，信用点我收下了。
lines.en: That's fair enough. I'll take the credits.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 空包我带走，过两天我拿单子过来取药。
lines.en: I'll take the empty bag. I'll be back with the list in a couple of days for the meds.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这几件带缺口的旧货根本值不了这么多，你少来这套。
lines.en: This chipped old junk isn't worth that much. Cut it out.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 队里急着买药我先收下，但你别指望我会跟你说谢谢。
lines.en: The squad needs medicine badly, so I'll take it. Don't expect a thank-you.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你压价压得也太狠了，就因为那两道小缺口吗？
lines.en: That's a brutal lowball. All because of two little nicks?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 算了，队里还等着用钱，今天先按这个数算。
lines.en: Fine. The squad needs the money. We'll go with that number today.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 谈不拢就算了，我把东西装回去。
lines.en: If we can't agree, forget it. I'll pack it back up.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 别的铺子我也能去问，就是不知道今天还能走多远。
lines.en: I can ask at other shops. Just don't know how far I'll get today.

segments.prompt: 她把单子推过来，等着拿货
segments.prompt_en: She slides the list over and waits for the goods

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 一张涂改过的手写补给单被按在窗口台面上。
lines.en: A handwritten supply list covered in corrections is pressed onto the counter.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 前天卖旧工具换的信用点都在这儿了。
lines.en: All the credits from selling old tools the day before yesterday are here.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我刚把单子改了。今天先把圈在最上面的退烧药和消毒剂拿齐。
lines.en: I just revised the list. Today I'll get the fever medicine and disinfectant circled at the top first.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 队里年纪最小的那个队员三天前胳膊划了道口子。
lines.en: The youngest member of our team got a gash on his arm three days ago.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 谁知道昨晚突然烧得直说胡话。
lines.en: Then last night he spiked a fever and started raving.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 都怪我前天光顾着先来出手旧工具，白白耽误了两天。
lines.en: My fault. The day before yesterday I was set on selling the old tools first and wasted two whole days.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 领队本来把底下的枪弹也画了圈，可手头的钱只够买一半。
lines.en: The team leader had circled the guns and ammo below too, but the money on hand only covers half.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 既然采买归我管，那就得先拿救命的药。枪弹留到下次再说。
lines.en: Since I'm in charge of supplies, lifesaving medicine comes first. Guns and ammo can wait till next time.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 绷带受过潮。
lines.en: The bandages are damp.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: （叹气）泛黄就泛黄吧。拿回去用开水煮过照样能用。
lines.en: (sighs) Yellowed is yellowed. Boil them when I get back and they'll still work.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 要是搁在以前……算了，以前在上面我早把杯子摔了。
lines.en: If this were before... forget it. Back when I was up above, I'd have smashed a cup already.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 几盒药剂、血袋和泛黄的绷带一字排开摆在窗口内侧。
lines.en: A row of medicine boxes, blood bags, and yellowed bandages is laid out inside the window.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 都在这，自己挑。
lines.en: It's all here. Pick what you need.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这袋血浆的日子还行。退烧药两盒，消毒剂三瓶，封口都没动过。
lines.en: The date on this blood bag is fine. Two boxes of fever medicine, three bottles of disinfectant. All seals unbroken.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 受潮的绷带我也一并带走。
lines.en: I'll take the damp bandages too.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 绷带算你便宜点。
lines.en: I'll discount the bandages.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 不用你让。该多少信用点就按多少算！
lines.en: No discount. Charge exactly what the credits should be!

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我花的是队里的公账，没道理在这儿欠你一份私情。
lines.en: I'm spending the team's funds. No reason to owe you a personal favor.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你也别想着给我抹零头，按实价开数就行。
lines.en: And don't round it down for me. Just charge the real price.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 往后队里的补给还是固定来你这儿拿。
lines.en: The team's supplies will keep coming from you from now on.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 别多想，我只是嫌别家掌柜的账目太乱，信不过他们。
lines.en: Don't get any ideas. I just find other shopkeepers' ledgers too messy to trust.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 照单给你结。
lines.en: I'll settle it by the list.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 先别急着算账。每样药我都得自己过手点一遍。
lines.en: Hold off on the bill. I need to handle and count every medicine myself.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 封口和数目对不上，我回去没法跟队里交差。
lines.en: If the seals and quantities don't match, I can't answer to the team.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 下半截什么时候拿？
lines.en: When will you get the second half?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 等队里再凑批旧货出手吧。今天把口袋翻烂也凑不够那个数。
lines.en: When the team gets another batch of old goods to sell. I can't scrape together that much today even if I turn my pockets inside out.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 先把眼前的药挑完要紧。
lines.en: The important thing is to finish picking the medicine here first.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 数目正好。药我装走了，下次有货再过来。
lines.en: The amount's exact. I'll take the medicine. I'll come by next time you have stock.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 不是让你按实价算吗？少收的那截我记着，下次连本补给你。
lines.en: I told you to charge the actual price. I'll remember what you undercharged and pay it back in full next time.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你趁火打劫的本事倒是一点没变。要不是队里急着救人……钱给你！
lines.en: You haven't lost your knack for price-gouging. If the team weren't in a hurry to save someone... here's your money!

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这个数我拿不下。我去隔街的铺子碰碰运气，不在这儿耗着了。
lines.en: I can't afford that. I'll try the shop across the street. No point wasting time here.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 埃莉诺把那张折过的补给单拍在窗口柜台上。
lines.en: Eleanor slaps a folded supply list onto the counter.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 把上次留下的单子下半截拿出来吧，今天只拿枪和子弹。
lines.en: Get out the bottom half of the list I left last time. Today it's just guns and ammo.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 发烧的那个好了？
lines.en: The one with the fever better?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 烧已经退干净了，昨晚还有力气嫌配给的营养果没味道。
lines.en: Fever's gone. Last night he had the energy to complain the ration Nutrifruit has no taste.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 最上面那行涂死了？
lines.en: Top line's blacked out?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: （她低头用指尖压住那道黑印）原本写的是护膝带。
lines.en: (She looks down, pressing a fingertip to the black mark) It said knee brace.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 队里有个人膝盖受过伤，一到阴冷天走路就吃力。
lines.en: Someone in the unit had a bad knee. Cold, damp days made walking hard.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 两天前晚上四个人出去办事，天快亮的时候只走回来三个。
lines.en: Two nights ago, four went out on a job. Near dawn, only three came back.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 他被人抬回来的时候已经没气了，这东西自然也就用不上了。
lines.en: He was already dead when they carried him in. So he won't be needing it.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你也去了？
lines.en: You went too?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 没有，我留在据点里核对库存和单子。
lines.en: No. I stayed at the base checking inventory and lists.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我是天亮听见动静出去帮忙的时候，才看到他被抬进来的。
lines.en: I heard the commotion at dawn and went out to help. That's when I saw them carry him in.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 领队说得对，再不把家伙补齐，下次少的人只会更多。
lines.en: The squad leader's right. If we don't restock our weapons, we'll lose more next time.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她用掌心把单子按平，抬眼看向窗口内侧。
lines.en: She smooths the list flat with her palm and looks up into the window.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 今天别的都不用拿，你把店里现有的枪和弹药取出来就行。
lines.en: Nothing else today. Just bring out whatever guns and ammo you have.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 要哪种？
lines.en: Which kind?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我直说了吧，其实我以前根本没碰过这些东西。
lines.en: I'll be blunt. I've never actually touched these things before.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 前几天在队里学压子弹，我还把方向塞反过两次，被旁边的人笑话了半天。
lines.en: A few days ago I was learning to load rounds and put them in backwards twice. They laughed at me for ages.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 所以我丑话说在前面，枪要是会卡壳或者有暗病，你必须当面讲清楚。
lines.en: So fair warning: if a gun jams or has a hidden flaw, you tell me to my face.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 弹药我只要整盒没拆封的，拆散的我得在柜台上一颗颗数过。
lines.en: Ammo only in sealed boxes. Loose rounds, I count one by one on this counter.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 有毛病的不拿。
lines.en: No faulty ones.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 价钱你也照实报，别因为我刚才说的话就私下给我抹零。
lines.en: And quote me the real price. Don't knock anything off because of what I just said.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 把你备好的枪和子弹推过来吧，我现在就清点。
lines.en: Push over the guns and ammo you've got ready. I'll count them now.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 数目和成色我都看过了，这批枪和子弹够队里应付一阵子了。
lines.en: Count and condition check out. These guns and rounds will hold the unit for a while.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 东西我先装包带走，等下次凑齐了经费再来找你。
lines.en: I'll pack these up. I'll be back once we scrape the funds together.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这价钱不对吧，你是不是又在私下给我算便宜了？
lines.en: That price is wrong. Are you quietly giving me a discount again?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这批货算队里公家的，你别拿可怜人那套来应付生意。
lines.en: This is the unit's purchase. Don't treat it like charity.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 看着我们急需武器就临时抬价，你这生意做得真够狠的。
lines.en: Raising the price because we're desperate for weapons. That's ruthless business.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 队里现在等着用枪，今天这口气我先咽下了。
lines.en: The unit needs guns now, so I'll swallow it today.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: （她合上手里的单子）拿去保命的枪可不能随便凑合。
lines.en: (She closes the list in her hand) I can't cut corners on guns that keep us alive.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这价钱我拿不下来，只能先回去跟领队想别的办法了。
lines.en: I can't afford that. I'll have to go back and find another way with the squad leader.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 埃莉诺穿了件战术背心站在窗口前，两手空空。
lines.en: Eleanor stands at the window in a tactical vest, empty-handed.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 别找账本了，我今天没带单子也没带货。
lines.en: Don't bother with the ledger. No list, no goods today.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 有事？
lines.en: Need something?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我就是顺路走过来，在外面待一会儿。
lines.en: I was passing by. I'll just stay out here a while.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 窗下椅子空着，坐吧。
lines.en: Chair under the window's free. Sit.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: （她走过去坐下，椅子晃了一下）啧，有条腿短了一截。
lines.en: (She sits; the chair wobbles) Tch. One leg's short.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你这店里连把能安稳坐人的椅子都凑不出来吗？
lines.en: Can't this shop manage one chair a person can actually sit on?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 没回配给站对面？
lines.en: Not going back across from the ration station?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那间小房子我前两天就已经退掉了。
lines.en: I gave up that little room a few days ago.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 既然每天都在队里忙活，干脆就搬进驻地住了。
lines.en: I'm with the unit every day anyway, so I moved into the base.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 搬走那天，同屋那个人还非要塞给我一条旧毯子。
lines.en: The day I left, my roommate insisted I take an old blanket.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 驻地不忙？
lines.en: Base not busy?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 今天上午，队里把前阵子没回来的那个人留下的东西拢了拢。
lines.en: This morning the unit gathered up what the one who didn't come back left behind.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 就一件厚外套和一双鞋，外加一个小铁皮盒。
lines.en: Just a heavy coat, a pair of shoes, and a little tin box.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 有人提了一嘴，问要不要把那件外套拿去换点药回来。
lines.en: Someone suggested trading the coat for some medicine.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 话刚说完，屋里所有人就都转过头看着我，等我拿主意。
lines.en: The moment they said it, everyone in the room turned to me to decide.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那你怎么说的？
lines.en: What did you say?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 还能怎么说，我只丢下一句明天再议，自己先走出来了。
lines.en: What could I say? I told them we'd discuss it tomorrow, and walked out.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 以前在上面心里烦的时候，我还能躲进母亲的温室里待着。
lines.en: Up above, when things got to me, I could hide in Mother's greenhouse.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 现在驻地里走两步就是人，连个能清静喘口气的地方都没有。
lines.en: At the base there are people every two steps. Nowhere quiet to breathe.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 比起来，反倒是你这破当铺的窗口外面更暖和清静一点。
lines.en: By comparison, outside your shabby pawnshop window is warmer. Quieter.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 远处的街区响起了换班的铃声，她扶着窗台站起身。
lines.en: A shift bell rings in a distant block. She steadies herself on the sill and stands.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 椅子我给你推回原位了，下次来之前记得把那条短腿垫平。
lines.en: I pushed the chair back. Shim that short leg before I come again.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 队里出事了？
lines.en: Trouble in the unit?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 没事，你少一上来就问东问西的。
lines.en: No. And stop interrogating me the second I show up.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 随你，我先理货。
lines.en: Suit yourself. I'll sort stock.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 哼，你忙你的正好，省得我还要费神应付你。
lines.en: Hmph. Good, go be busy. Saves me the effort of dealing with you.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我又来了，今天还是不买东西。
lines.en: Me again. Still not buying anything.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 椅子空着，自己拉。
lines.en: Chair's free. Pull it up.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 埃莉诺坐下后，把四折的纸和一张压平的糖纸放上柜台沿。
lines.en: Eleanor sits and sets a paper folded in four and a flattened candy wrapper on the counter's edge.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这是队里现在的名单，我昨晚重抄了三遍。
lines.en: This is the unit's current roster. I recopied it three times last night.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 驻地墙上贴着的那份，第七行已经用黑墨划掉了。
lines.en: On the one posted at the base, line seven is struck out in black ink.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 但我手里留的这份，第七行还空着。
lines.en: But on the copy I kept, line seven is still blank.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 半杯热水搁在窗口柜台沿上，店里一时安静下来。
lines.en: Half a cup of hot water rests on the counter by the window, and the shop falls quiet.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: （她手指拢住温热的杯壁）那个人左膝一直不太好。
lines.en: (Her fingers close around the warm cup) His left knee was always bad.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 一遇上管道返潮就疼，连爬楼梯都比别人慢半拍。
lines.en: It hurt whenever the pipes got damp. He was a beat slower on stairs than everyone.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 可每次队里分发药品，他总是默不作声排在最后。
lines.en: But whenever the unit handed out medicine, he'd quietly get in line last.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 他平时难得能分到一颗糖，吃完了也舍不得扔。
lines.en: He rarely got a piece of candy, and even after eating it he wouldn't toss the wrapper.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 每次都把糖纸一张张压平，收在那个小铁皮盒里。
lines.en: He flattened every wrapper and kept them in that little tin box.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 他说等攒满了一整盒，就能去换一顿上层区的饭。
lines.en: He said once the box was full, he could trade it for a meal on the Upper Level.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我当时还泼他冷水，说上面根本没人收这种废纸。
lines.en: I threw cold water on it. Told him nobody up there takes that kind of trash.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 他听完也不恼，就挠着头冲我笑。
lines.en: He didn't get mad when he heard that. He just scratched his head and grinned at me.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 他说那就留给我，因为我是从上面下来的。
lines.en: He said I should have it, then, since I came down from up there.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 上午打开盒子看的时候，其实还差一点才装满。
lines.en: When I opened the box this morning, it actually wasn't quite full yet.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 单子上那条护膝带，每次都被我排在药和子弹后面。
lines.en: That knee strap on the list, I always put it after meds and ammo.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 买东西的先后顺序，明明都是我亲手定的。
lines.en: And I'm the one who set the order we buy things in.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 护膝带救不了那天晚上。
lines.en: A knee strap couldn't have saved that night.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那也轮不到你来替我开脱！
lines.en: That doesn't mean you get to make excuses for me!

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……算了，你说得对，是我自己在钻牛角尖。
lines.en: ...Forget it. You're right. I'm just tying myself in knots.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 有时候我真不知道，除了跑单子和点子弹，我还剩什么。
lines.en: Sometimes I honestly don't know what's left of me besides running lists and counting bullets.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你别接话，我不是来向你讨答案的。
lines.en: Don't answer. I didn't come here asking you for answers.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 第七行你还空着。
lines.en: Line seven's still blank.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: （她低头看着那行空白）你眼神倒是一如既往地毒。
lines.en: (She looks down at the blank line) Sharp-eyed as ever, aren't you.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这张糖纸我先折进名单里收着，第七行就这么留着吧。
lines.en: I'll fold this candy wrapper into the list for now. Line seven can stay blank.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 至于他留下的那件外套，明天我还是拿去换消毒水。
lines.en: As for the coat he left behind, I'm still trading it for antiseptic tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 咦，这把破椅子今天怎么一点都不晃了？
lines.en: Huh. Why isn't this junk chair wobbling at all today?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 拿硬纸片垫了。
lines.en: Shimmed it with cardboard.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 哼，算你还有点店主的自觉。
lines.en: Hmph. Guess you've got some sense of being a shopkeeper after all.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我得回驻地赶早清点药品了，以后没单子我也照样来坐。
lines.en: I need to get back to base early to count meds. Even without a list, I'll still come sit here.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 第七行是那个人？
lines.en: Line seven is him?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 嗯，名字我就不提了，反正说了你也不认识。
lines.en: Yeah. I won't say his name. You wouldn't know him anyway.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 不过那张糖纸，确实是从他留下的铁皮盒里翻出来的。
lines.en: But that candy wrapper really did come from the tin box he left behind.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 今天要什么？
lines.en: What do you need today?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我刚才不是说了吗，今天什么都不买。
lines.en: Didn't I just say? I'm not buying anything today.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 就是看这张糖纸闷在铁皮盒里太久，拿出来透透气。
lines.en: This candy wrapper's just been shut in that tin box too long. Figured it needed some air.

segments.prompt: 她站在窗外，外套搭在胳膊上，一直没坐
segments.prompt_en: She stands outside the window, coat over her arm, still not sitting.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 天还没亮，半拉开的卷帘窗外响起两下很轻的敲击声。
lines.en: Before dawn, two soft knocks sound outside the half-raised shutter window.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 吵醒你了？我看里面还亮着灯。
lines.en: Did I wake you? I saw the light was still on.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 刚醒，还没开门。
lines.en: Just woke up. Not open yet.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我没带单子，手里也没有货。
lines.en: I didn't bring a list. No goods on me either.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那就站窗口喘口气。
lines.en: Then stand at the window and catch your breath.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我杀了人。
lines.en: I killed someone.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 就在后半夜那场行动里。
lines.en: In the operation late last night.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 驻地那边一屋子都是人，这话我没法跟他们提。
lines.en: Back at base the room's full of people. I can't bring this up with them.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 你从窗口伸手接过她胳膊上的外套，放到柜台边。
lines.en: You reach through the window, take the coat from her arm, and set it by the counter.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 袖口湿着，还有硝烟味。
lines.en: The cuffs are wet. They smell of gunsmoke.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 回来的时候拿冷水搓过两遍了。
lines.en: I scrubbed them twice in cold water on the way back.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那股味跟长在布料里一样，怎么都散不干净。
lines.en: The smell's like it grew into the fabric. It won't come out no matter what.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 先放这儿晾着吧。
lines.en: Leave it here to dry for now.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 领队这次让我带着队里年纪最小的那个一起走。
lines.en: This time the squad leader had me take the youngest in the unit with me.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 转过拐角的时候，对面的人先举起了枪。
lines.en: When we turned the corner, the one on the other side raised his gun first.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那个小家伙当时就贴在我左手肘边上。
lines.en: The kid was right up against my left elbow.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 枪口正对着他，我脑子里什么都没来得及想。
lines.en: His gun was pointed right at him. I didn't have time to think.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 手指自己就扣下去了。
lines.en: My finger just pulled the trigger on its own.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 可笑吧，前阵子我还是个连子弹都会装反的人。
lines.en: Funny, right? Not long ago I'd load bullets in backwards.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 结果刚才那一枪稳得离谱。
lines.en: And that shot just now was absurdly steady.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那个队员没事？
lines.en: The squad member's okay?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 没事，刚回驻地那会儿还有精神嫌早饭凉了。
lines.en: Fine. Back at base he had energy to complain breakfast was cold.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 所以我一点也不后悔开那一枪。
lines.en: So I don't regret that shot one bit.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 可对面倒下不动的时候，枪口还笔直飘着一缕细烟。
lines.en: But when the other guy went down and stayed down, a thin wisp of smoke rose straight from the muzzle.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我现在只要一闭上眼，满脑子就全是那缕散不掉的烟。
lines.en: Now every time I close my eyes, that smoke is all I see. It won't clear.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 你把窗外那把垫稳的旧椅子往她手边推了推。
lines.en: You push the old, steadied chair outside the window closer to her.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 别站着，坐下。
lines.en: Don't stand. Sit.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 外衣上全是后半夜沾的味，我坐这儿缓口气就行。
lines.en: My coat reeks of the small hours. I'll just sit here and catch my breath.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 你倒了一杯温水，推到窗口柜台沿上。
lines.en: You pour a cup of warm water and slide it to the edge of the window counter.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 手凉，先喝口热水。
lines.en: Your hands are cold. Drink something warm.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 谢了，我先把手指头贴杯壁上缓一下。
lines.en: Thanks. I'll warm my fingers on the cup first.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 天刚蒙蒙亮，店里留着盏暗灯，窗外那把旧椅子昨晚就没收回去。
lines.en: Barely dawn. A dim lamp is still on in the shop. The old chair outside the window never got brought in last night.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你这椅子昨晚干脆就没往里搬吧？
lines.en: You didn't even bother bringing this chair in last night, did you?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你倒是挺会算计我什么时候过来，今天也没带单子。
lines.en: You've got my schedule figured out. No list today, by the way.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 热水。这半块是我早饭。
lines.en: Hot water. This half is my breakfast.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 不算补给，不记账。
lines.en: Not supplies. Not on the books.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: （接过面包咬了一小口）干得简直能噎死人。
lines.en: (Takes the bread and bites off a little.) Dry enough to choke on.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 不过比营养果强多了，这话你可别让队里听见。
lines.en: Still beats Nutrifruit. Don't let the unit hear I said that.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 手比前两天稳了。
lines.en: Your hands are steadier than a couple days ago.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 还是有一点抖，但总算不像那天似的控制不住了。
lines.en: Still shaking a little, but at least not like that day, when I couldn't stop it.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 昨晚闭上眼，枪口那缕细烟散了一半，天亮前勉强睡了一会儿。
lines.en: Last night when I closed my eyes, half that smoke was gone. I managed some sleep before dawn.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 喂，我大清早跑来这儿坐着的事，你千万别往队里说。
lines.en: Hey. Don't you dare tell the unit I come sit here at the crack of dawn.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 驻地那边现在都觉得我稳得像块石头，连领队都打算让我带人了。
lines.en: Everyone at base thinks I'm steady as a rock. The squad leader even wants me leading people.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这时候要是露了怯，底下的人心里该没底了。
lines.en: If I show nerves now, the ones under me will lose their footing.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那个年轻队员呢？
lines.en: And the young squad member?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 别提了，那小子昨天居然跑来问我眼睛怎么红了。
lines.en: Don't get me started. Yesterday the kid actually asked why my eyes were red.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我没好气地把他训了一顿，让他先把散开的鞋带系紧。
lines.en: I snapped at him and told him to tie his loose shoelaces first.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 结果他现在一看见我，第一件事就是低头检查鞋带。
lines.en: Now the first thing he does when he sees me is check his shoelaces.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 埃莉诺把剩下的一小角面包用纸包好，仔细揣进衣兜里。
lines.en: Eleanor wraps the last corner of bread in paper and tucks it carefully into her pocket.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 留着路上垫肚子吧，我得赶回去点算弹药了。
lines.en: I'll save it for the road. I need to get back and count ammo.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 下次不用等到开门。
lines.en: Next time, don't wait for opening.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 谁答应过你还有下次了？
lines.en: Who said there'd be a next time?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这窗下冷风嗖嗖的，冷得要命。
lines.en: The wind under this window cuts right through you. It's freezing.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你要是愿意留着椅子吹冷风，那也随你的便。
lines.en: If you want to leave the chair out in the cold, suit yourself.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 一只扎紧的帆布袋搁上窗口台面，里头金属碰撞发出闷响。
lines.en: A tied canvas sack lands on the counter, metal clanking dully inside.

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 你就是这家当铺的掌柜吧？
lines.en: You're the shopkeeper here?

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 埃莉诺两天前，天还没亮就跟着队伍出发了，这一趟少说得十天。
lines.en: Eleanor set out with the squad two days ago, before dawn. This run'll take at least ten days.

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 她临走前特意交代我，仓库里多出来的材料只管往你这儿送。
lines.en: Before she left she told me to bring any surplus materials from the depot straight to you.

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 说是你这儿给价痛快，不爱磨嘴皮子。
lines.en: Said you give a straight price and don't haggle.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她走之前还顺利吗？
lines.en: Was everything smooth before she left?

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 那姑娘办事，比我们这帮老油条还较真。
lines.en: That girl takes things more seriously than us old hands.

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 出发头一晚，她攥着张手写单子，挨个查全队的背包。
lines.en: The night before they left, she went through every pack in the squad with a handwritten list.

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 有个老队员嫌烦不乐意，她也不吵，就抱起胳膊在旁边站着盯。
lines.en: One old-timer got annoyed. She didn't argue, just crossed her arms and stood there staring.

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 盯到那老小子自己发毛，解开包一翻，还真漏了一卷绷带。
lines.en: Stared until he got nervous, opened his pack, and sure enough, a roll of bandages was missing.

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 队里最年轻那毛头小子，鞋带松了她一眼就瞅见。
lines.en: The youngest kid's bootlace came loose and she spotted it right away.

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 硬是站在跟前催了三遍，看着人打成死结才肯挪步。
lines.en: Stood there and made him retie it three times, wouldn't move until it was double-knotted.

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 她自己那个包本来就塞得最沉。
lines.en: Her own pack was already the heaviest.

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 临出发前，她愣是把全队大半的急救药全揽过去塞进了自己包里。
lines.en: Right before they set off, she took most of the squad's first-aid supplies and stuffed them in her own pack.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 很像她会干的事。
lines.en: Sounds like her.

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 谁说不是呢，刚来那会儿我们还当是个娇生惯养的大小姐。
lines.en: Tell me about it. When she first came we figured she was some pampered rich girl.

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 现在队里上下，没人敢拿她当外人看。
lines.en: Now nobody in the squad treats her as an outsider.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 军需官解开帆布袋口的麻绳，露出里头擦拭干燥的废金属与金属锭。
lines.en: The Quartermaster unties the sack, revealing scrap and ingots wiped dry.

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 行了，不扯闲话了，说正事。
lines.en: All right, enough talk. Down to business.

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 这袋子废金属和金属锭都是提前晾干的，她走前亲自点过数、封好口。
lines.en: This scrap and these ingots were dried in advance. She counted and sealed them herself before leaving.

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 我们留守的人手头紧，急着折现买批口粮。
lines.en: Those of us left behind are short on funds and need to cash out for rations.

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 我按市面折个价出给你，你给掌掌眼，看看能出多少？
lines.en: I'll go by market rate. Take a look and tell me what you can offer.

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 怪不得她认准你这儿，办事确实敞亮。
lines.en: No wonder she picked your shop—you're straightforward.

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 这笔钱正好拿去换口粮，谢了。
lines.en: This money will go straight to rations. Thanks.

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 给得比我预想的还宽裕些，这下留守的弟兄们能多添点干粮了。
lines.en: More generous than I expected—now the men staying behind can get extra dry rations.

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 这份情我记下了，等她回来我一定如实跟她说。
lines.en: I'll remember this. When she's back, I'll tell her exactly.

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 你这手压得有点狠啊……不过眼下急着买口粮，也只能先换了。
lines.en: You drive a hard bargain... but with rations urgent, I'll take the deal.

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 钱我点清了，先走了。
lines.en: Money's counted. I'm off.

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 这数实在合不拢，低于仓库定好的底价我也没法向队里交差。
lines.en: The numbers just won't work. I can't go below the warehouse's fixed floor price and still answer to the crew.

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 东西我先拎回去，改天再说吧。
lines.en: I'll take my goods back. We'll talk another day.

segments.prompt: 战士说完，弯腰去提地上的包
segments.prompt_en: Done talking, the fighter bends to pick up the bag

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 一名裤腿沾满泥的革命军战士一瘸一拐地走到营业窗口前。
lines.en: A Revolutionary Fighter, pants caked in mud, limps up to the service window.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 老板，埃莉诺让我顺路过来找你。
lines.en: Eleanor told me to stop by on my way back.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 脚怎么了？他们人呢？
lines.en: What happened to your foot? Where are the others?

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 大部队还在前头，我走到第五天踩空崴了脚。
lines.en: The main unit's still up ahead. On day five I misstepped and twisted my ankle.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 领队嫌我留着拖慢脚程，就派我先折返回来了。
lines.en: The squad leader said I'd slow them down, so he sent me back early.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 半道上我们端了对面一个哨卡，缴获了点手枪和弹药。
lines.en: On the way we took out an enemy checkpoint and seized some pistols and ammo.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 埃莉诺交代我把这批货直接拿来你店里变现。
lines.en: Eleanor told me to bring the haul straight here and cash it in.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 前头的路不好走？
lines.en: Rough road ahead?

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 可不是嘛，前两天经过一段塌方的窄道。
lines.en: You said it. A couple days back we went through a narrow, half-collapsed passage.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 里头黑得伸手不见五指，领队只能在最前头探路。
lines.en: Pitch black in there. The squad leader had to scout up front.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 埃莉诺断后带着我们五个人，每走几步就低声点一遍名。
lines.en: Eleanor took the rear with the five of us, calling roll under her breath every few steps.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 她还拿绳子把队里最年轻那小子拴在自己左手边。
lines.en: She even roped the youngest kid in the unit to her left hand.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 那么黑的塌方道，硬是一个没落地全让她带出来了。
lines.en: That collapsed passage was black as anything, and she got every one of us out.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 后来我脚崴了走不动，也是她二话没说拽过我半个背包。
lines.en: Later I twisted my ankle and couldn't keep up. She took half my pack without a word.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 她把那半个包甩自己肩上，就冷着脸丢给我一句闭嘴跟紧。
lines.en: Slung it over her shoulder, gave me a cold look, and said, "Shut up and keep up."

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她人怎么样？
lines.en: How is she?

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 她精神头硬着呢，半点事都没有。
lines.en: Tough as ever. Not a scratch on her.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 歇脚时她还蹲下来，一边训人一边帮那年轻小子重系鞋带。
lines.en: When we rested, she crouched down and retied that kid's laces while chewing him out.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: （拍了下脑门）差点把她私下交代的正事给忘了。
lines.en: (Slaps forehead) Almost forgot what she told me in private.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 临分头前她把我拉到一边，压低嗓门嘱咐了我三句话。
lines.en: Before we split up, she pulled me aside and gave me three things, real quiet.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 第一句是让我顺道帮她瞅一眼，看你这店还正常开着没。
lines.en: First, swing by and check if your shop's still open.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 第二句是让你千万别把她的杯子收起来。
lines.en: Second, tell you not to put her cup away.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 第三句是让你见到货照常给价，别在那儿磨叽发愣。
lines.en: Third, when you see the goods, give a normal price. No dawdling or spacing out.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 战士解开帆布包，把缴获的左轮手枪和几盒弹药放到柜台上。
lines.en: The fighter opens a canvas bag and sets a captured revolver and a few boxes of ammo on the counter.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 话我可一字不落带到了，老板你给看看这些枪弹能出多少。
lines.en: That's every word, delivered. Now, what'll you give me for these guns and rounds?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 先把货拿出来看看。
lines.en: Let's see the goods first.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 行，反正她人好着呢，老板你尽管放心。
lines.en: Sure. Anyway, she's doing fine. Don't you worry.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她会带人回来的。
lines.en: She'll bring them back.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 那可不，我们队里属她最认路。
lines.en: Damn right. Nobody in our unit knows the routes like she does.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 有她盯着单子和路线，谁也丢不了。
lines.en: With her watching the list and the route, nobody gets lost.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 痛快，难怪埃莉诺非让我上你这儿来。
lines.en: Straight deal. No wonder Eleanor insisted I come here.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 钱我收好了，这就回驻地养脚等大部队回来。
lines.en: Got the money. I'll head back to base, rest my foot, and wait for the others.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 嘿，老板你出手可真够爽快的！
lines.en: Hey, you don't haggle at all!

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 等埃莉诺回来，我一定替你多说两句好话。
lines.en: When Eleanor's back, I'll put in a good word for you.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: （皱起眉头）老板你这价压得也太狠了点。
lines.en: (Frowns) That's a pretty brutal lowball.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 算了，我这脚疼得厉害，懒得再拎着跑别家了。
lines.en: Forget it. My foot hurts too much to haul this somewhere else.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 这价钱差太多，我可没法回去跟埃莉诺交差。
lines.en: That's way too low. I can't face Eleanor with that.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 东西我还是拎走，去别处问问价吧。
lines.en: I'll take my stuff and ask around elsewhere.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 一名风尘仆仆的革命军游击队大步走到营业窗口前。
lines.en: A travel-worn Revolutionary Guerrilla strides up to the service window.

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 老板，先给你报个天大的好消息！
lines.en: Boss, I've got huge news!

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 我们整支队伍全平平安安回来了，一个人也没少！
lines.en: Our whole unit made it back safe. Not one missing!

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 我是前哨先一步赶回来的，大部队明后天就能进站。
lines.en: I'm the advance scout. The main group reaches the station in a day or two.

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 这一路紧赶慢赶，可算能歇口气了。
lines.en: We rushed the whole way. Finally I can catch my breath.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 别坐那把椅子。
lines.en: Not that chair.

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: （刚弯下腰又猛地站直）哟，是我没眼力见了。
lines.en: (Starts to sit, then straightens up fast) Whoa, my bad.

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 早听说你这窗外专门给人留着座，果然名不虚传。
lines.en: Heard you keep a seat by this window for someone. Guess it's true.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 返程路上还顺利吗？
lines.en: How was the trip back?

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 后半程人人体力见底，走起来最磨人。
lines.en: Second half, everyone was running on empty. That's the worst stretch.

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 埃莉诺硬是主动揽了殿后的活，一路盯着大伙的脚程。
lines.en: Eleanor insisted on taking the rear and kept an eye on everyone's pace the whole way.

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 队里最年轻那小子也算争气，咬着牙一步都没落下。
lines.en: The youngest kid in the squad did well too. Gritted his teeth and never fell behind.

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 不过有件事我悄悄透给你，你可别说是从我嘴里漏的。
lines.en: But here's something on the quiet. Don't say you heard it from me.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她怎么了？
lines.en: What happened to her?

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 前天翻一堵塌了一半的矮墙，她拿左手托了别人一把。
lines.en: Day before yesterday, climbing a half-collapsed wall, she gave someone a boost with her left hand.

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 结果左胳膊让墙头翘起的铁皮划了一道口子。
lines.en: A piece of sheet metal sticking up on top sliced her left arm open.

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 好在伤口不算深，就是看着有点渗人。
lines.en: Luckily it's not deep. Just looks nasty.

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 她愣是没舍得动队里的急救药，自己撕了布条勒紧缠上了。
lines.en: She wouldn't touch the squad's first-aid supplies. Tore up some cloth and bound it tight herself.

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 缠完还板着脸下令，叫大伙谁也别拿这点小伤瞎操心。
lines.en: Then she ordered, straight-faced, that nobody waste worry on a scratch like that.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她还交代别的没有？
lines.en: She say anything else?

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 她确实私下塞给我一句口信，让我一定带到。
lines.en: She did slip me a message in private. Said I had to deliver it.

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 她让你在店里替她留一根能量棒。
lines.en: She wants you to save her an energy bar at the shop.

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 依我看，等她回来你可千万别一照面就问胳膊的伤。
lines.en: If you ask me, when she's back, don't bring up the arm the second you see her.

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 她那脾气你最清楚，最烦别人盯着她的伤口看。
lines.en: You know her temper. She hates people staring at her wounds.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 游击队解下背上的帆布袋，把几把格斗刀和重铁管放上柜台。
lines.en: The guerrilla unslings a canvas bag and sets several combat knives and heavy iron pipes on the counter.

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 这些是路上缴获的近战家伙，老板你给估个价吧。
lines.en: Melee gear we seized on the road. Give me a price on these.

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 跟老板做买卖就是省心，钱我收好了。
lines.en: Always easy doing business with you. Got the money.

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 能量棒你可得给她留好，她最迟明天就到。
lines.en: Keep that energy bar for her. She'll be here tomorrow at the latest.

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 看来老板今天心情相当不错，出手这么大方！
lines.en: Someone's in a good mood today. That's generous!

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 那我就替后头的大部队先谢过你了，回见！
lines.en: I'll thank you on behalf of the main group behind me. See you!

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: （撇了下嘴）这价压得实在有点低了。
lines.en: (Purses lips) That's a pretty lowball price.

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 算了，我还赶着回去报信，就按这个数结吧。
lines.en: Fine. I need to get back and report. We'll settle at that.

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 这价钱我可没法向队里交差，家伙我先收起来了。
lines.en: I can't take that price back to the squad. I'll hold on to the gear.

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 买卖不成仁义在，那根能量棒你可千万别忘了留。
lines.en: No deal, no hard feelings. Just don't forget to save that energy bar.

options.label: 说门一直留着
options.label_en: Say the door was always open.

options.label: 问她伤要不要紧
options.label_en: Ask if her wounds are serious.

segments.prompt: 她站在门外，手还扶着椅背，没往里走
segments.prompt_en: She stands outside, hand still on the chair back, not stepping in.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 清晨卷帘门刚拉起，埃莉诺已经坐在窗外那把垫稳的椅子上。
lines.en: Early morning. As the shutter rolls up, Eleanor is already sitting outside the window in the steadied chair.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你今天倒是起得挺早。
lines.en: You're up early today.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你什么时候来的？
lines.en: When did you get here?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 也就刚坐下没多久，刚才听见你在里面响动，就没敲窗。
lines.en: Not long ago. Heard you moving around inside, so I didn't knock.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这把椅子，你居然还真的一直替我留着。
lines.en: You actually kept this chair for me the whole time.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 能量棒也给你留着。
lines.en: Kept the energy bar too.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: （拿起能量棒捏了捏）算你守信，这顿算我先欠着。
lines.en: (Picks up the energy bar and squeezes it) Good, you kept your word. I'll owe you for this one.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 昨晚回来的？
lines.en: Got back last night?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 嗯，后半夜刚进的驻地，我挨个清点了一遍人数。
lines.en: Yeah. Reached the camp after midnight. I did a headcount, one by one.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 带出去的人全都平平安安带回来了，一个都没少。
lines.en: Everyone I took out came back safe. Not one missing.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 最年轻的那个小子也全须全尾地跟着队伍走到了最后。
lines.en: Even the youngest kid made it to the end with the squad, all in one piece.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 口袋里那张名单，还是只有第七行空着。
lines.en: The list in her pocket still has only the seventh line blank.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 怎么不多睡会儿？
lines.en: Why not sleep in?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 点完名回屋躺下了，翻来覆去怎么也睡不着。
lines.en: Lay down after roll call. Tossed and turned, couldn't sleep.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 索性趁着天还没亮透，顺着路走过来透透气。
lines.en: So before it got fully light, I walked over for some air.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 埃莉诺站起身，缠着干净绷带的左臂搭在椅背上，没有迈步离开。
lines.en: Eleanor stands, her left arm in clean bandages resting on the chair back. She doesn't walk away.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你这儿刚开门，我是不是耽误你整理货架了？
lines.en: You just opened up. Am I keeping you from stocking the shelves?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 不耽误，再待会儿。
lines.en: You're not. Stay a while.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: （手指轻轻摩挲着椅背）既然你都这么说了，那我就再占你一点时间。
lines.en: (Fingers lightly tracing the chair back) Well, since you put it that way, I'll take a little more of your time.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 反正驻地那边上午也没什么急事，我就站在这儿歇口气。
lines.en: Nothing urgent at the base this morning anyway. I'll just stand here and catch my breath.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 这扇窗一直留着。
lines.en: This window stays open.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 少说这种好听的话，我可没打算天天往你这儿跑。
lines.en: Spare me the sweet talk. I'm not planning to come running here every day.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 胳膊上的伤没事？
lines.en: Your arm okay?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 肯定又是前哨那家伙多嘴，明明千叮万嘱让他别乱说的。
lines.en: Bet that guy at the outpost ran his mouth again. I told him a hundred times to keep quiet.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 就是被铁皮蹭破了一点皮，早上已经重新换过干净绷带了。
lines.en: Just a scrape from some sheet metal. I put on clean bandages this morning.
